1-on-1 Technical Mentoring

Technical Mentoring & Coaching

Expert guidance on any technical challenge, wherever you are in your career.

You don't need another course. You don't need a curriculum. You need someone in your corner who's been doing this for 30 years — someone who can look at your specific situation and help you move forward with clarity and confidence.

I offer personal 1-on-1 mentoring and coaching on any technical topic. Architecture decisions, production debugging, career strategy, team dynamics, tooling choices, code quality — if it's a challenge you're facing as a developer, we can work on it together. No slides, no predetermined path. Just focused work on your actual challenges.

What Can We Work On?

Whatever technical challenge you're facing — I've likely seen it before and can help you navigate it.

🏗️

Architecture & Design Patterns

System design, scaling decisions, choosing the right patterns for your problem.

🔍

Debugging & Problem Solving

Production issues, systematic debugging approaches, root cause analysis.

📈

Career Growth & Advancement

Leveling up, navigating promotions, building your reputation as an engineer.

⚙️

DevOps & Tooling

CI/CD, containers, infrastructure decisions, developer experience.

✅

Code Quality & Reviews

Writing maintainable code, review practices, testing strategies.

🤖

AI Tools & Workflows

Integrating AI into your development process, prompt engineering, AI-native thinking.

👥

Team Dynamics & Leadership

Stepping into tech lead roles, managing up, building effective teams.

🧭

Technology Decisions

Evaluating frameworks, languages, platforms — making choices you won't regret.

...whatever you're working on

How It Works

1

Book a Discovery Call

A free 30-minute conversation where we talk about where you are, what you're working on, and what kind of support would help most.

2

Define Your Goals

Together we identify the specific challenges, decisions, or skills you want to focus on — and build a plan around your actual work.

3

Regular 1-on-1 Sessions

Ongoing sessions tailored entirely to you — weekly, biweekly, or whatever cadence fits. Every session is grounded in your real challenges.

🤖

Featured Offering

AI Coaching — Weekly Group Sessions

Stop Experimenting With AI. Start Mastering It.

What

A recurring weekly session focused on building genuine AI fluency — tools like ChatGPT and Claude, prompting systems, AI-native development, and workflow automation. This is a systematic approach to making AI a real part of how you work.

Format

Weekly group format — learn alongside other developers and founders. Get the benefit of shared perspectives while building real skills you can apply immediately.

Who It's For

Developers and founders ready to go beyond dabbling. If you've played with AI tools but haven't built a system around them — if you know there's a gap between where you are and where you could be — this is where you close it.

What You'll Build

  • Real fluency with AI tools — not just surface knowledge
  • Prompting strategies tailored to your work
  • AI-native development workflows that compound
